Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap

Class RecapDataSourceConfig

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap.RecapDataSourceConfig
@Configuration public class RecapDataSourceConfig extends Object
The reporting service's two connection pools. Every report reads through the main pool, which stays read-only so an accidental write fails loudly; recaps are the one thing this service writes, through a small pool of its own that only RecapSnapshotRepository uses.

Declaring a second DataSource turns off Spring Boot's own, so the main pool is declared here too, bound to the same spring.datasource properties as before: reports, JdbcTemplate and the session check see no difference.
